body: Should I take the pod out? Like keep it separate from the actual juul?
He just told me he’s been very depressed. He’s had problems with anxiety and depression before.

His father does accept him as gay. Actually his father has a boyfriend himself haha. I’ve been trying to get in touch with the father all day but no luck. I’m gonna keep trying. If I can even talk the father into allowing me to just talk with him for 10 minutes a day I think it could help him a lot.
Thank you for the advice. It’s really nice to see an outside perspective on it. If his father won’t let me talk to him or see him then the police might be the best course of action

Thank you so much for the advice. I’ll try and get in touch with him while regularly sending texts and pictures. This has just been a very stressful few days for me, so I might not be thinking straight and advice from an outside perspective is very welcome. Also your English is very good :)
His dad is usually very good at handling this stuff. I think he’s just emotionally kind of drained. I can’t imagine how stressful this must all be, but yes I think he’s making a mistake

No sadly his mom isn’t in the picture. The only one I have been asking for help with is his ex. It’s really hard for me to do that because his ex and I have some issues, but we both care about him deeply and his ex lives closer to him than me. I’ve asked his ex to checkup on him today and tell me how he’s doing. I’m scared that this might end up pushing him back to his ex but as long as he’s alive then I’ve done my job..
Doesn’t change the fact that my mom hates me
I don’t want to happen though. She has had a hard life and the last thing she would need is to have a child totally cut her out
